tex_content.html:
Definition
[Gromov--Hausdorff convergence (unbounded diameter)] ↗ def:gromov-hausdorff-convergence

For based metric spaces $(X_k,x_k)$ (not necessarily of finite diameter) to converge in the Gromov-Hausdorff sense to a based metric space $(Y,y)$ means that for each $r>0$ there is a sequence $\delta _k\rightarrow 0$ such that the sequence of balls $B(x_k,r+\delta _k)$ in $(X_k,x_k)$ converges in the Gromov-Hausdorff sense to the ball $B(y,r)$ in $Y$.
